Did this at level 20. You will NEED Master of Deception rank 3 for the second key and you need to do this solo.

You can pick up the quest at the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/object=410369/dead-drop]Dead Drop[/url] around 47,71 in Silverpine Forest, just outside Pyrewood Village in a house near Shadowfang Keep. This is where the letter from 'C' sends you, and it is also the same cache you will return to later to complete the quest and for the final payment.

In short, you need to get into the courtyard in Shadowfang Keep, pickpocket two specific enemies for two half-keys, combine them into the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=210209/twin-key]Twin Key[/url], then use that key to open a chest in the stables for the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=210183/horn-of-xelthos]Horn of Xelthos[/url].

To get past the the courtyard door you have two options:

[ol]
[li]You can go to Stonetalon Mountains, pickpocket the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=210187/venture-co-work-order]Venture Co. Work Order[/url] from Venture Co. enemies in the Windshear Crag and bring it to [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=4086/veenix]Veenix[/url], who gives you the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=210186/breaching-charge]Breaching Charge[/url]. You can then use that to blow open the courtyard door in Shadowfang Keep.[/li]
[li]Or you can open the prison cell and talk to the NPC. If you do it that way, you’re going to die, but once he opens the door it stays open when you run back.[/li]
[/ol]

Once you’re through, you need to pickpocket two enemies that only spawn when doing this solo:
[ol]
[li][url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=211765/gemela]Gemela[/url] is in the dining hall where Baron Silverlaine is, just inside from the kitchen. Pickpocket her for the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=210213/sisters-half-key]Sister’s Half-Key[/url].[/li]
[li][url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=211764/gefell]Gefell[/url] is further on, go up the stairs past Silverlaine and take the right instead of the normal route left. He is in the first room around the corner. Pickpocket him for the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=210212/brothers-half-key]Brother’s Half-Key[/url].[/li]
[/ol]

Once you have both halves, find somewhere safe and combine them into the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=210209/twin-key]Twin Key[/url]. Keep in mind that combining them will take you out of stealth. Then go back down to the courtyard and into the stables. There is an Ornamented Chest in there, open it with the Twin Key and you’ll get the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=210183/horn-of-xelthos]Horn of Xelthos[/url].

Also, the reward doesn’t show up straight away. After you finish the quest at the cache, go to a major city. You’ll get another mail from 'C' saying your payment is waiting in the cache again. Go back there and you can pick up the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=277210/pyrewood-signet-ring]Pyrewood Signet Ring[/url].

[b]Step 1[/b]
[ul]
[li]After reaching Level 30, you'll get mail that you can get a new Quest at Pyrewood Village (47.1 ,  71.1)  - Same location as the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=78261/the-horn-of-xelthos]Horn of Xelthos Quest[/url]  [/li]
[/ul]
[b]Step 2[/b]
[ul]
[li]Go behind the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades into the Stables (81.2 , 32.1) - you will find a Chest there providing you with [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=210955/scarlet-initiates-uniform]Scarlet's Initiate Uniform[/url][/li]
[/ul]
[b]Step 3[/b]
[ul]
[li]Go into the Graveyard and find a [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=4293/scarlet-scryer]Scarlet Scryer[/url] , Pickpocket that NPC for [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=210963/scryers-key]Scryers Key[/url][/li]
[ul]
[li]Note: You can already use your Scarlets Initiate Uniform here, but once you enter Stealth you will drop the disguise anyways[/li]
[/ul]
[/ul]
[b]Step 4[/b]
[ul]
[li]Leave the Graveyard section and head into the Libary (across the Hall of the Scarlet Monastery), Put on your Scarlets Initiate Uniform, Head into the Second to Last Room and Loot the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/object=412759/personal-letterbox]Personal Letterbox[/url] for [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=210967/confidential-message]Confidential Message[/url][/li]
[/ul]
[b]Step 5[/b]
[ul]
[li]Go back to the Graveyard - go to the actual graveyard Section and on the left and right side you will find a bench on each side of the dungeon -  /sit on that (you can do that in stealth
[ul]
[li]Once you /sit on either bench you should see a message in the chatbox [quote]You hear a faint click[/quote] twice (once per bench) and then [quote]You hear the sound of stone moving[/quote] - that way you know it worked. 
[/li]
[/ul][/li]
[/ul]
[ul]
[li]Then just ahead in the mausoleum you see a Chest that you can loot for the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=210968/reliquary-key]Reliquary Key[/url].[/li]
[ul]
[li]If a Elite Ghost is guarding the Chest, go outside the Graveyard and [i]reset the instance[/i]. There is a chance of no Monster in front of the Chest or just a non-elite Ghost. [/li]
[ul]
[li]Note: If you reset the instance you have to sit on the benches again to activate the mechanism[/li]
[/ul]
[/ul]
[/ul]
[b]Step 6[/b]
[ul]
[li]Go to the Library once more, put on your disguise, head to the first small room on the left in the latter part of the dungeon, loot the chest for [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=210953/eye-of-bhossca]Eye of Bhossca[/url][/li]
[/ul]
[b]Step 7[/b]
[ul]
[li]Go Back to(47.1 ,  71.1)   and turn in the quest[/li]
[/ul]
[ul]
[li]Go to any Major City and you will receive Mail from 'C' that you can pick up your reward, once again in Pyrewood Village (47.1 ,  71.1)  [/li]
[/ul]
[ul]
[li]Go back to the Chest / [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/object=410369/dead-drop]Dead Drop[/url] in Pyrewood Village (47.1 ,  71.1) to pick up your reward [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=277246/ruby-adorned-blade]Ruby-Adorned Blade[/url] [/li]
[/ul]
 

Enjoy!

comments.body:
Step-by-Step Solo Route
Get your disguise: Before entering either wing, grab the Scarlet Initiate's Uniform disguise from the Supply Locker chest in the stables outside the monastery.
Wing 1 - Graveyard (Left Portal): Put on your disguise and head into the Graveyard. Go to the first large room (Chamber of Atonement) and Pick Pocket a Scarlet Scryer (or Scarlet Crier) to get the Scryer's Key.
Wing 2 - Library (Right Portal): Leave the Graveyard and enter the Library wing. Proceed to the Athenaeum section to find the Personal Letterbox. Open it with your Scryer's Key to find a Confidential Message instructing you to "sit on the benches between the two statues" back in the Graveyard.
Back to the Graveyard: Return to the Graveyard wing. Follow the instructions from the note to sit on the benches, then head into the northern mausoleum (Forlorn Cloister) to loot a Stone Coffer for the Reliquary Key.
Back to the Library: Return to the Library wing one last time. Go deep into the dungeon to the Gallery of Treasures and use your new key to open the Padlocked Reliquary to loot the Eye of Bhossca.

When I got to Deathguard Falgan, he was already alive.  I turned in the quest for him, then started to read the quest text for the next part without accepting it.  I got layered at that point and he was dead.  I thought I had soft-locked myself, but then just used the Symbol to Rez him and I was able to accept the next part of the chain.  I would guess if you no longer have the symbol, you could just wait for someone to rez him on your layer.

There is a quest turn-in marker on your minimap at Deathguard Falgan's location. I thought I'd have to find his corpse myself so I was searching the Scarlet Crusade camp and the surrounding trees, only to realize that I didn't need to do that at all.

Also, hand the quest in immediately. if you take too long, Dalgan will die again. This is presumably so that other paladins doing their class quest can also resurrect him. If he does die, you will need to run all the way back to Bandarion Keep to get another Symbol of Life from Danitha Morr before running all the way back to Falgan's corpse.
